_note: D45: every player-facing living-world string, keyed by a stable id (en = the baseline; other languages copy this file and translate the values). {placeholders} come from the caller; tools/living-world/i18n.mjs renders them and throws on a missing key.
feed.GUARDIAN_KO.0: {attacker} broke the Warden of {place}: {pot} CT bounty
feed.GUARDIAN_KO.1: The Warden of {place} falls to {attacker}, who split {pot} CT
feed.GUARDIAN_UNBOUND.0: {attacker} shattered all three Ward Stones and unbound the Ascendant of {place}: {pot} CT
feed.GUARDIAN_UNBOUND.1: The Ascendant of {place} is unbound! {attacker} take the {pot} CT bounty
feed.GUARDIAN_OUTLASTED.0: {attacker} outlasted the Ascendant of {place}; it tired and fell. Half bounty: {pot} CT
feed.GUARDIAN_OUTLASTED.1: The Ascendant of {place} tired before {attacker} did: {pot} CT
feed.GUARDIAN_HELD.0: The {form} of {place} held; the stake goes home to {defender}
feed.SIEGE_ME_BROKEN.0: {defender} dared the world to take {place}. {attacker} did: {pot} CT in spoils
feed.SIEGE_ME_BROKEN.1: {place} falls on a dare: {attacker} split {pot} CT
feed.SIEGE_ME_HELD.0: {defender} dared, and {place} held: {attacker} lost {losses} units at the walls
feed.SIEGE_ME_HELD.1: {place} stood its SIEGE_ME window; the dare pot rolls to {defender}
feed.BOUNTY_CLAIMED.1: Bounty paid: {target} brought down by {attacker} ({pot} CT)
feed.CARAVAN_RAIDED.0: {attacker} raided a caravan bound for {place} and took the cargo
feed.CARAVAN_RAIDED.1: A caravan to {place} never arrived: {attacker} took it on the road
feed.CARAVAN_ESCORTED.1: Escort paid: {attacker} saw the caravan through to {place}
feed.AIRDROP_TAKEN.0: {attacker} held the {sponsor} airdrop at {place} for 20 s and took the crate
feed.BARBARIAN_CAMP_CLEARED.0: {attacker} burned the barbarian camp near {place}: 48 h of quiet for the region
feed.BARBARIAN_CAMP_CLEARED.1: The raids stop: {attacker} cleared the camp by {place}
feed.KRAKEN.0: The Kraken took a fleet on {lane}; it was dragged to Blackmere
feed.KRAKEN.1: Kraken sighted on {lane}: {attacker} turned back in time
feed.STORM_CLOSES.0: Storm: {count} sea lanes from {place} are closed today
journal.win.BARBARIAN_CAMP_CLEARED: Broke a barbarian raid {where}: 48 h of quiet for the region
journal.win.AIRDROP_TAKEN: Held the airdrop crate {where} for 20 s and took it
journal.win.CARAVAN_RAIDED: Took a caravan on the road {where}
journal.loss.poi: Beaten back at the {poi} {where}. They'll remember you.
banner.ascendant: ⚠ the Ascendant of {place} stands for {left}: 8 min of power from first contact, 3 Ward Stones
